Search by name or INCI. Primary keyword EMBRAE ingredients Secondary keywords skincare ingredient directory; Ectoin skincare; niacinamide panthenol ceramides skincare; INCI list skincare India; climate-responsive skincare ingredients Logic Shoppers who reach this page already know the brand and want to check what is in a product, so the brand plus "ingredients" is the primary keyword. Secondary keywords cover the ingredient names people look up (Ectoin, niacinamide, panthenol, ceramides) and the INCI term, which is how ingredient lists are searched. All 68 ingredients sit as plain HTML text, so each name and INCI name can be found by search engines and by the page search box. Developer notes Search matches ingredient name and INCI name. The product menu filters by product. Each "Found in" name links to its product page (update the links to the Shopify product handles). The list is generated from the approved ingredient workbook (68 rows), so new ingredients and extra detail fields can be added as new rows or columns without changing the layout. Open items for approval 1) The workbook lists "Barrier Reset Cleanser" for Sodium Hyaluronate. Shown as "Reset Cleanser" to match the product name. 2) British spellings in the workbook (stabilise, moisturisation) were changed to US spelling. No other wording changed. 3) The workbook has no row for some hero ingredients named on the product pages (for example Pentavitin, Hyaluronic Acid, Rice Water). Please confirm which listed INCI name each one maps to, so shoppers can find them. 4) Alpha-Arbutin is described as "used in skin-brightening formulations". Please confirm this claim is approved for a sunscreen page. 5) Ectoin is the only ingredient written up with a signature line. More detail per ingredient can be added when the next batch arrives.
